LESSON: CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.4: Creative writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creative writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. write clearly with a variety in sentence structure, length, and pattern
2. use appropriate connecting words to sequence sentences
3. exhibit artistic expression through writing e) choose to write independently during free 169 choice activities picture spark Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners organize and write their thoughts in pairs and groups Creativity and critical thinking: learners look, think and write based on a given picture prompt

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. write clearly with a variety in sentence structure, length, and pattern
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to write clearly with a variety in sentence structure, length, and pattern. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use appropriate connecting words to sequence sentences
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate connecting words to sequence sentences. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. exhibit artistic expression through writing e) choose to write independently during free 169 choice activities picture spark Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners organize and write their thoughts in pairs and groups Creativity and critical thinking: learners look, think and write based on a given picture prompt
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to exhibit artistic expression through writing e) choose to write independently during free 169 choice activities picture spark Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners organize and write their thoughts in pairs and groups Creativity and critical thinking: learners look, think and write based on a given picture prompt. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creative writing.
2. Explain Creative writing to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners give feedback on their in sentence structure, classmate's writing length, and pattern
4. Show that you can: write clearly with a variety in sentence structure, length, and pattern
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creative writing. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Creative writing important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners give feedback on their in sentence structure, classmate's writing length, and pattern
2. Learners practice sequencing c) use appropriate connecting sentences to form creative texts in words to sequence pairs and groups sentences
3. Learners are provided with d) exhibit artistic expression pictures as a trigger to creative through writing writing e) choose to write

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. write clearly with a variety in sentence structure, length, and pattern
2. use appropriate connecting words to sequence sentences
3. exhibit artistic expression through writing e) choose to write independently during free 169 choice activities picture spark Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners organize and write their thoughts in pairs and groups Creativity and critical thinking: learners look, think and write based on a given picture prompt

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
